label: A perfection caused in another is received in that other, from participation
meaning: Derives the batch 1 bridge that a perfection caused in another is received in it from two OPEN premises: what x has from a distinct cause it has by participation, and a perfection had by participation is received in its participant. It does not use STMT-PARTICIPATED-HAS-OTHER-CAUSE, whose direction (participation to being caused) is the converse of the first premise.
